steps.html: Build the Necrofluid Gauntlet (Stabilizer Chip → Klaus → Aether Barrel → cube at Vandorn Farm).
Upgrade Ol' Tessie: PaP (2 power pumps), Abomination Beam (Cook zombie → Freeze Key → carcass).
DG-2 Turret barrel optional for the challenge step.
Wisp Tea at Tailor Shop → spirit into mirror → shoot with Gauntlet → Powder of the Forgotten.
Yuri’s Lab: match the three Pigpen words on the chalkboard, top to bottom, to the required ingredients.
Interact ingredients top→bottom → add your blood (lockdown, heal via Gauntlet kills) → fill serum with zombie souls → Serum.
Freeze Ashwood clock tower with DG-2 Turret → shoot clock face with Gauntlet → purple charges (3 per round, 1 per frozen face).
Stand on floor numeral matching the farmhouse clock → look at Pa → shoot his head → 4 orbs fly.
Find 4 ritual items (Tasty-Face, Junior's Fun-Face, Pa's Pigsticker, Ma's Chalice) → place on glowing circles → defend lockdown.
Shoot 2 radar dishes (purple) → monitors light up, 3 souls float.
Match the Pigpen word on the monitors, then lock each two-digit value left to right using the red buttons.
Souls vanish → Soyuz rocket launches.
Trigger colored lightning (round start or shoot 3 spark poles with DG-2 turret).
Shoot service station clock with purple Gauntlet → freeze time 1 min.
Revive 3 corpses: trucker (ram container), mechanic (Klaus, garage), waitress (melee cash register).
Lead each zombie to its colored lightning bolt before timer ends.
Interact with floating soul at the pier.
Shoot projector (purple) → 4 images = film reel order → shoot reels in order (wrong = jumpscare, next round retry).
Open the box with Speed Cola → soul flies → Klaus takes Hellion Horn.
Klaus blows the horn → red orbs with white mist at 4 locations: Monolith Forest, Collapsed Tower, Grounded Ship, Lost Cabins (3 each) — collect by driving over them (timed).
Teleported (with Tessie) to Veytharion's Sepulcher.
P1: missiles, green barnacles heal, spin immunity → beam → overcharge → ram to stun → shoot weak point.
P2: heavier barrages, fewer heals, faster immunity cycles.
P3: tracking laser — counter with boost or ram during charge-up; maximize burst on short weak-point windows.
Defeat → final cinematic. Continue the game! Then interact with the Mysterious Object at Blackwater Lake to unlock Relics.
Acquire the LGM-1 (see Key Features).
Starting at Round 10, follow O.S.C.A.R. until it calls out three planets. Convert planets to numbers by their distance from the Sun (Mercury = 1, Neptune = 8).
Enter the 3-digit code at the Observatory Dome terminal; a lift drops with a corpse and a key.
Go to Machina Astralis, open the cryopod with the key to reveal a corpse.
Shoot the glass at Museum Infinitum to grab the Saw, return to the pod, and take the brain.
Place the brain on the table in the Luminarium and defend during the short lockdown.
Bring the brain to the machine near the teleporter in Machina Astralis to power it; it will list book titles.
Use the Observatory Dome telescope (requires trap activation or LGM-1) to find Mars coordinates (4-digit code).
Enter the code at the Machina Astralis machine; it confirms Mars.
In Archive of Orbis, match the three busts to the counted book titles from their shelves (do this at round start for time).
When correct, climb the opened panel to grab the Neptune model and place it atop Machina Astralis.
Collect three planet notes (directions + planet): Luminarium desk, Machina Astralis table, Archive of Orbis table.
Align the planets on the model display to the noted directions (compass around the Sun model).
Return to Machina Astralis, interact with the brain to reboot the portal, defend against O.S.C.A.R.; you will be sent to Mars.
Pick up the brain at the arena center, place it in the machine up the stairs, and create the portal.

Each round, play the machine sound to spot the ascendant eye; while it flies, shoot pylons: Back Right > Back Left > Front Right > Front Left > temple pylon above the machine. Grab the eye when it dives.
Place the ascendant eye in the device on the right side of the arena (facing where you shot pylons).
With the LGM-1, shoot the antennas of the five arena pillars until each shows a symbol and a song plays.
Back in Observatory Dome, read the organ screen: it shows the five symbols in order with one missing (denoted by wavy lines). Note the missing symbol and its position.
Return to Mars and interact with the pillars in that exact order, inserting the missing symbol where indicated.
Interact with the machine atop the stairs to start the fight against Caltheris.
Kill zombies to charge the Tesla coils. Activate the machine to fire at Caltheris; repeat on the opposite side while avoiding lasers and lava.
When Caltheris reforms as a small golem, keep moving and damage her glowing blue weak point.
Restock during immunity, then continue targeting the weak point. Jump over the slam shockwave.
In the final phase, avoid the purple pools, faster movement and stronger slam. Deplete her remaining health to finish the fight.
Obtain the Blundergat and upgrade to the Sundergat.
Normal Shoot Yellow backyard’s swing; take its seat. Destroyed RC-XD race → Chalk → return seat and chalk to the swing → Twins scene.
Destroyed Seeds: Yellow garage’s red toolbox. Normal Plant left of Trinity Ave PaP and feed the tree souls with either Blundergat.
Destroyed Throw 3 Combat Axes at the tree for firewood. Normal Place it in Yellow House’s fireplace and light with a Molotov.
Destroyed Stand on Trinity Ave’s X until it stays blue. Normal Watch the scene; hop 1→12→1, avoiding smoke (30s retry wait).
Normal Feed the golden music box souls with the Sundergat; escort it to the fireplace.
Destroyed Turn the Green backyard Piano Teacher with Brain Rot/Psych. Follow it indoors, then quickly teleport to Normal for its piano scene.
Destroyed Record each note’s blink count and collect in 1–8 order. Normal Green House piano: 8 6 7 5 6 5 3 5.
Destroyed Kill 3 floating backyard zombies. Normal Trinity Ave ball trial: kill airborne zombies before the ball lands. Feed the music sheet souls with Sundergat; escort to piano.
Destroyed Shoot the top of the speaker pole at Trinity Ave PaP; use Wisp Tea to retrieve the Goggles.
Destroyed Death Perception reveals the Headset. Normal Interact with the blue toy box by Trinity Ave’s crates.
Destroyed Shoot the red ball to Green backyard’s X. Normal Start Four Square; melee the ball between squares, allowing just one bounce per square, until time ends.
Normal Feed the cymbals souls with Sundergat; escort to the toy box.
After all three branches: Destroyed shoot crumbled clock → both hands to 0.
Start teleporting to Normal; shoot the red hand once just before the teleport animation ends.
White orb appears → scene: piano → toy box → fireplace → Twins at the swing with a yellow portal → boss fight.
P1: 3 goo piles (Trinity/Yellow/Green House) → fill cysts with souls → clear goo → defend Concentration Field on each revealed object → damage orange spots; redirect tornadoes with Molotovs.
P2: Rad-Hounds spawn; kill from green orbs to clear goo → defend fields again → ⅔ health.
P3: Shock Mimics; bring Tortured Zombie to each object & kill to clear goo → defend → finish the Heart.
Obtain the Jotunn Star (wonder weapon).
Crowbar in Lighthouse; find the note (Dry Dock / Tyr's Foot) → read the crate code: III-6, V-7, X-9, or IV-3.
Open the matching crate → Flak Gun Round. (Wrong crate = 30s penalty.)
Load the flak gun near the Lighthouse, shoot the Riese head in spawn.
Take Transmitter from Riese head → place in Tyr's head (2nd floor).
Count the 2 sets of blinking lights → 2×2-digit numbers.
Core Foundry Ascender (Molotov) → console: calibrate Amplitude + Frequency → fire both sets → Wunderbarrage Controller.
U-1: Fishing Rod → glowing green fish → Irradiated Ravager next round → kill for Uranium.
U-2: ARC-XD melee vent → secret room → head jars A–E + radioactive symbols → Necrospike lockpick → Uranium.
U-3: Glocke Drop → shoot floating zombies, light 3 green lights → Uranium.
Clear debris (Wunderbarrage) → Machine Workshop → record the six existing tubes and place three Uranium tubes to keep the gauge in its target range → Atomkraft Core.
Defend generator (Quick Revive pallets) → Charged Core to Storm Bridge barrel → Dravakar Shard.
Place shard on Blodheim Hall bonfire → light with Jotunn Star ranged attack.
Disciple Injection → throw zombies into fire → lockdown → kill Necropincer HVT → Sunstone.
Sunstone in Eidskallen Stave Church center → giant arrow circle → shoot rune wood piles in order (arrow count = order).
Return to Tyr's Head console → boss fight.
Shoot red weak spots while Tyr wrestles; ice attacks freeze areas → use 3 Flammenfalle traps.
Tyr disabled → Gjallarfrost heads: grenade in mouth or Jotunn Star ranged to stun → destroy; dodge ice shard runes, shoot random weak spots.
More Gjallarfrost heads; middle area locked, no cover — keep DPS on weak spots until health bar empties.
Build & upgrade the Maneki-Neko, obtain the Nekomancer.
Lantern Step: shoot 11 lanterns (timed!) → spirit corpse in War Room → Ceramic Shards.
Mask Step: Ninja Kite → Fox Mask → Simon Says ×3 → blue mask.
Suspect: hide-and-seek mask → 3 items (Pipe, Comb, Case) → Meditation Room shelves.
Accomplice — Merchant: Coin Purse at spawn → apple zombie → kill at merchant window → Abacus.
Gardener: fill Bucket (3 waters!) → water 3 plants → shoot glowing flowers → Shears.
Noble: 3 decoys at windows → reflect grenades → Hat.
Monkshood: Empty Pouch → Plant + Volcanic Ash (fissure) → pot + tornado → flower.
Plum Pit: punch fruit in Kitchens → jump until gold seed.
Pufferfish: need Pestle → kitchen bowl soul box → ghost → fish.
Location (need Saka Cup): 3 soul boxes → War Room, Collapse Study, Tea Garden (chase dog).
Motive: Netsuke of Brothers (Stables statue) + Hanko (first Oni).
Clock Puzzle: storage clock ×4 → assault wave → read Japanese numbers → allocate up to two flags per area → final evidence.
Saka Cup: repair ceramic shards at Tea Garden table.
Pestle: scroll pattern in Storage Rooms → Doctor's Note.
Paintings 1–5: match the evidence using the trap ghost, Death Records, Poison Compendium and fourth painting’s background.
Purify World Seed: follow light → mini-boss → dragon takes seed. (Perfect run → Katana in PaP room.)
Expel the Onryo: incense bowls → glowing orb → Shogun's Sanctum → World Seed → Onryo fight (shoot its masks to break immunity).
Nyxara: 3 fishes on pole in PaP room → fast travel → volcano boss.
Unlock Pack-a-Punch and collect the Void Claw. Follow the Warden’s Blight route through the Fracture and recover its three parts.
Dravakar Sanctuary: match the wall riddle to its lever pulls, confirm at the center pillar and forge Warden’s Blight.

Shoot the basketball in the house roof. Record four symbols across the next four rounds; shoot them in that order on an Exfil round. Exfil to Her House, retrieve the Eye of the Forge and upgrade a Void Claw pedestal.
Veytharion's Sanctuary: collect the 4 cubes (pillar by GobbleGum, 2 windows in Mule Kick room, near Void Claw pedestal).
Left opening bottom→top: Fire, Hand, Water, Leaf. Shuffle to the right opening → Water, Leaf, Hand, Fire. Fire must never touch Leaf/Water; slide empties if a round ends.
Shoot/melee the circle to move the slide. Reward: swirling pool + Random Perk. Interacting with the pool triggers rain the next round (needed for every temple cleansing).
With Void Talon: free the 3 pillar Pull Switches + 6 panels around the Nexus Core.
Clear the webs (explosives/Molotov, Astral/Ursuper Flam, or Warden's Blight) — Deathspinners spawn.
Purple orb → Pack-a-Punch → surge, then quickly interact the ground Pull Switch next to Deadshot Daiquiri at the Nexus Core bottom.
Pillars around the Forge can now be moved.
Align the 3 pillars in front of each temple first.
Per temple: quest item → cauldron + Astral Flame shot → attach floater to a zombie → its symbol matches a Titan Trap shackle (Caltheris / Veytharion Passage) → trap it.
Tile mini-action → reflector: Dravakar re-plate several times · Nyxara prone · Caltheris aim 30 s · Veytharion keep jumping.
Lift reflector (charged Warden's Blight) → aim beam at the marked wall → kill zombies beneath → wall breaks.
Shoot Visage → lockdown → destroy 4 Shadow Souls → shoot again until screen turns white.
Purple orb under the face + Warden's Blight lift → purple eyes → rain + Astral Flame to the face point = cleansed.

Items: Dravakar — Blacksmith's Hammer (Shatter Blast shields) · Nyxara — Ancient Scroll (Shadow Rift in forest) · Caltheris — Shimmering Thread (purple orbs) · Veytharion — Woven Sash (rain; Spira / Ruinas / Aranea Insula).
Start in the Nexus Core circles. Void Claw/Talon recommended — he pushes you out of the arena.
P1: Dread Skulls (Dead Wire) stun him → shoot the tail critical point.
Immune: destroy Shadow Souls (Light Mend) → P2: destroy Stingers (Cryofreeze) or they trigger a wipe; dodge stun circles.
Intermediate room: survive or kill the HVT. P3: armor-providing Shadow Souls + skulls. P4: more skulls before each stun.
Open the route from rooftops to subway Power Room; try the power switch.
Kill marked Tempests → collect both fuses → install → switch power on.
Checkpoint Charlie Disciple encounter → Pack-a-Punch → Brain Rot for Hotel 305.

cw-mauer-der-toten.title: Klaus — hands, battery, blacklight and first upgrade

steps.html: Brain Rot a zombie in Hotel 305 → let it open bedroom → collect hands.
Round-10 Krasny Soldat battery + hands → Safe House Klaus → take remote.
Klaus opens Switch Control locker → Blacklight. Death Strip dig piles → dish → Garment Factory.
Let Klaus earn kills → green station monitor → send him in → defend first upgrade.

cw-mauer-der-toten.title: Free CRBR-S and the hidden laboratory

steps.html: Blacklight numbers: dial 1 Garment Factory → dial 2 Service Passage → dial 3 Grocery Store.
Hotel 305 safe → enter three room values → collect CRBR-S.
Klaus breaks Sewer Access brick wall → CRBR-S Blazer melts metal → enter lab.
Clear the lab Tormentor round → collect three canisters → shoot lure dispenser.

cw-mauer-der-toten.title: Three harvesters and Klaus’s hacking headgear

steps.html: Find active harvester → insert canister → throw lure → kill Tempests beside it.
Return each filled canister to the lab; repeat for all three active harvesters.
CRBR-S: rooftop antenna / Ghost Station electronics / store radios → install headgear on Klaus.

cw-mauer-der-toten.title: Stop the train and recover the warhead

steps.html: Upgraded Klaus → Railway Switch → command onto far track from Mule Kick.
Stopped train: collect Rico’s Keycard AND Bomb, then get out.
Install Bomb → keycard at Safe House computer → browse to satellite connection.
Satellite → marked Megaton + splits → two uranium rocks; watch the live countdown.
Craft two devices → opposite Penthouse/Korber zipline ends → collect collision drop.
First cleansed piece into warhead → next satellite cycle → make second cleansed piece.
Prepare everyone BEFORE the second cleansed uranium deposit.
Shield → health; cover from blue wipe, kill healing zombies, resupply between arenas.
After Valentina, protect Klaus carrying the Bomb into the portal.
Activate the six generators by staying within their capture areas and defeating the attacking templars. All six must be powered to use Pack-a-Punch.
Collect shield parts around the generator routes and build it at a workbench. Take a shovel from a starting location and dig marked sites for equipment.
Collect the gramophone in the excavation and the black record near the mound. Place the gramophone to open the lower excavation, then retrieve it for the elemental tunnels.
Each staff needs its colored record, three parts and the crystal from its matching Crazy Place portal. Leave the portal open until you return, then recover the gramophone.

Ice: dig glowing excavation sites while it is snowing, searching the spawn, middle and church regions for its three parts. Take the blue record from the Tank Station area and obtain the ice crystal through the church tunnel.
Fire: collect the part dropped by a Panzer, shoot down the glowing plane and collect its drop, and take the Generator 6 reward part. Find the red record around the church and obtain the fire crystal.

Wind: enter each giant robot through its lit foot by shooting the panel before it steps down. Collect one part inside each robot, find the yellow record around Generator 5 and obtain the wind crystal.
Lightning: use the tank to reach all three elevated part locations; plan the jump before riding past each platform. Find the purple record near Generator 4 and obtain the lightning crystal.
Return to the excavation pedestals and build each staff. Collect its crystal before trying to assemble it.

Ice: match each shown tablet to its ceiling symbol in the Crazy Place. Use the linked source chart when identifying shapes. Back on the map, freeze the three tombstones, then break each with a bullet weapon.
Fire: kill zombies on the Crazy Place grates with the staff until the cauldrons light. Decode the glowing church symbols into torch numbers and light the corresponding torches with the fire staff.
Wind: set the Crazy Place rings to the wind pattern shown in the reference guide, then redirect the three smoking stone balls toward the excavation with the staff.

Lightning: number the seven lower keyboard triangles from left to right. Shoot 1–3–6, wait for the sparks to clear, then 3–5–7, wait, then 2–4–6. Ignore the upper row. Rotate the sparking electrical panel switches around the map until they stop sparking.
For each staff, align the excavation rings to its color, shoot the orb beneath them, then place the staff in its Crazy Place pedestal and feed it kills until charged. Retrieve the upgraded staff.
Fill all four soul chests in the robot footprints without letting a robot reset an unfinished chest. Collect the Thunder Fists from a reward chest.
Take a tablet from the Tank Station to the church water basin. Earn nearby melee kills to clean it, then carry it back without touching mud. If it becomes dirty, return to the basin and try again.
Place the clean tablet back in the Tank Station and earn the required melee kills to unlock G-Strikes. Build the Maxis Drone from its three parts.
Place upgraded staffs in the quest pedestals: ice in the church robot, wind in the middle robot, lightning in the spawn robot, and fire in the excavation.

After the placement step completes, retrieve the staffs. Press a robot’s red button and quickly throw a G-Strike onto the sealed ground near Generator 5. In co-op, assign the button and throw to separate players.
Once the seal opens, deploy the Maxis Drone into it. Defeat the spawned Panzers before continuing.
Use Zombie Blood to see and shoot the glowing plane, then locate and kill its pilot while the effect is active. Collect the drone it drops.
In the lower excavation, use melee attacks on the special smoke-trailing zombies until the upgraded-fist tablet appears; collect it.
Place all four upgraded staffs in the Crazy Place and feed the final soul requirement. When the portal opens, deploy the upgraded Maxis Drone and use the final interaction to finish the quest.

bo4-dead-of-the-night.title: Sentinel, shield & the three tuning forks

steps.html: Sentinel on → expose and charge purple, green and blue stones.
Clock = hold circle; perk = vampire lockdown; object/painting = ghost escort.
Three shield pieces → Smoking Room workbench.
Use three forks at Forest Terrace; kill the werewolf with silver if ready; reach Pack-a-Punch.

bo4-dead-of-the-night.title: Silver bullets → Folly → Chaos Theory → Annihilator

steps.html: Three silver objects → Wine Cellar; three powder ingredients → Library silver bullets.
Record four colored shapes; set matching dials and interact with the Library case.
Silver werewolf material → process; shield-bash Library shelf → blue part; craft Chaos Theory.
Follow four orange lamps; shoot the released bat; collect its material.
Tornado-kill vampires → collect bile → red coffin → kill Crimson Nosferatu.
Green charged effect on enemy beside mushroom mound → let it dig → collect component.
Process both materials; use the right Laboratory bench for Alistair’s Annihilator.

bo4-dead-of-the-night.title: Telescope — beams, visual zodiac & electric shields

steps.html: Revisit the stones to activate all three branches.
Silver-shot rod together → Atlas wheels: middle/green, left/blue, right/red; repeat.
Find three active sign areas; record all three scratch groups for each.
Dial: lowest total → middle → highest; melee to submit each symbol.
Shield out: turn dome crank fully, bash to lock; electrify shields; bash eyepiece together.
All interact with stone; survive lockdown; kill final werewolves; collect the stone.

bo4-dead-of-the-night.title: Knights — three fireplace runs & forest triangle

steps.html: Library blue fire → flaming shield → bash a whole fireplace sequence.
Smoking → Library right → Library left → Billiards; collect gem.
Run 2: Mozu-side Hall → East → other Hall → West. Run 3: Trophy → Bedroom → Music → Dining.
Animate Main Hall, Gardens and Cemetery armor; escort each gem to its matching Forest circle.
Feed each knight twice → silver-kill werewolf inside triangle → lockdown → collect stone.
Shoot five birches with Annihilator; interact with every dropped branch.
Matching player uses 1912 grave → fireball at effigy base → interact to enter ghost mode.
Find woman in ghost mode; escort to Cemetery; interact with her stone to exit.
Exit ghost mode; start group lockdown; collect third stone; resupply.

bo4-dead-of-the-night.title: Werewolf boss — reveal, trap & damage the chest

steps.html: Full shield, silver ammo, upgraded damage weapon; group at Forest boss door.
Aim three statue beams into green square; lure boss inside; shoot glowing chest.
Boss retreats → supplies → survive the mixed enemy wave.
Final stage: find hidden square using green beams; trap and damage until the ending.

bo3-der-eisendrache.title: Power, Pack-a-Punch, dragons and Ragnarok DG-4

steps.html: Power → activate four pyramid plates → open Wundersphere landing pads.
Assemble Pack-a-Punch; feed courtyard, Church and Undercroft dragons → collect base bow.
Collect Panzer, Death Ray and rocket-test parts → build Ragnarok DG-4 and shield.
Solo/ranked: prepare the required player-count bows. Unranked/offline: all four.
Choose and complete each needed elemental branch.
Void: hear names → inspect matching knights → record their actual glyphs.
Reforged arrow → matching pyramid chest → souls → exchange the base bow.

bo3-der-eisendrache.title: Wisps, first time travel and the safe code

steps.html: Base bow: teleporter prongs → upgraded bow: four active wisps.
Purple teleporter → collect fuses + canister → record safe symbols top to bottom.
Fuses → Protect → safe code → collect disk/coils → install both coils → Destroy.

bo3-der-eisendrache.title: Terminal memory, second time travel and Keeper circles

steps.html: Solve both terminal boards → press the green Death Ray button → crash the pod.
Second trip: use machine → collect tablet; collect golden rod from the crash.
Follow Keeper → stand inside each circle → use its indicated bow; place tablet at Double Tap.
Fit the canister → resupply → every player plants charged Ragnaroks on a separate plate.

bo3-der-eisendrache.title: Keeper boss and the final terminal

steps.html: Central charge → plant Ragnaroks → shoot glowing chest; use pillars against the wipe attack.
Return → collect Summoning Key → Clock Tower terminal → ending.
Power → three colored cylinders → defend three modules → collect their circuits.
Install circuits in Operations Bunker → dragon ride → Hatchery Pack-a-Punch.
Collect three shield pieces → build in Operations Bunker.

bo3-gorod-krovi.title: Dragon Strike and Gauntlet of Siegfried

steps.html: All players activate Hatchery crystal → survive four waves → collect Dragon Strike.
Collect egg → heat in dragon fire → cool → napalm, penetration and melee trials.
Incubate and defend egg → cool → collect → claim Gauntlet at spawn.
Power Hatchery generator → find green-light room and pink-cylinder room.
Use the calculated five settings → collect cylinder at the unchanged endpoint.
Insert cylinder → spell KRONOS top to bottom → submit.

bo3-gorod-krovi.title: Collect and install all six trophies

steps.html: Statue hand + shield-blasted pipe + Supply Depot laser trap.
Dragon Strike puddle + Gauntlet-punch safe + sewer red light / Hatchery toilet.
Install trophies → activate monitor → complete five random challenges, then download.
Bombs: record the six real flashes → defuse exactly in that order.
Gersh: find yellow orb → Pack-a-Punched damage → listen → follow and repeat.
Escort green-eyed drone from spawn to SOPHIA without damaging it.
Find green-eyed Mangler → maintain its attention → lure it to Dragon Command.
Protect distant module → send whelp for cargo → return cargo to SOPHIA.
Take keycard → Hatchery computer / lockdown → retrieve downloaded card → SOPHIA.

bo3-gorod-krovi.title: Deliver the power core and fight the dragon / Nikolai

steps.html: Whelp delivers core to Nikolai → SOPHIA leaves → all players enter grate → arena button.
Dragon: survive fire → shoot each exposed orange weak point → repeat.
Nikolai: destroy four exposed outer weak points → central core → ending.

cw-firebase-z.title: Three reactors, Pack-a-Punch and the RAI K-84

steps.html: Ravenov → rooftop portal → defend all three reactors → village Pack-a-Punch.
Blueprint → Scorched Defense eye → retina scanner key → Barracks lockers → Mimic barrel.
Watch three computer stops → match sectors below → shoot board numbers in order → bullseye.
Mangler cell → Weapons Lab charger → wait for pickup prompt → build RAI K-84.

cw-firebase-z.title: Ravenov’s badge and Peck’s truth serum

steps.html: Peck → Ravenov badge → compounds from Equipment Storage, Engineering and Colonel’s Office.
Mix in Field Hospital → kill Hellhounds → collect delivery system → OPC air conditioner.
Finish Peck dialogue → upstairs Data Center station → take Essence Trap.

cw-firebase-z.title: Mimic memories — recognize the correct spawns

steps.html: Find disguised-loot Mimic → weaken → trap at close range → return to Data Center in three minutes.
Accept Sokolov, Brahms and Zhabin; a rejected memory is not progress.
Disk → Planning Offices → enter OPC → Peck dialogue → Aethermeter locker + Scorched Defense shovel.

cw-firebase-z.title: Three crystal tests — visual differences and recovery

steps.html: Open Lot: dig → inspect copies → choose the container without black particles.
Jungle Defense: dig → survive inside dome → collect container.
Barracks: locate moving container → RAI K-84 slowing orb → collect before it moves.
Install crystals at all three reactors → return to OPC → wait for satellite instruction.

cw-firebase-z.title: Align the satellite and defeat Orda

steps.html: Planning Offices: select the “?” satellite and confirm alignment.
Resupply → OPC terminal starts the finale.
Shoot Orda’s glowing mouth, avoid its slam, clear adds and use village resupply.
Banner: complete three challenges. Ring four tower gongs; four heads into the Temple.
Build the Brazen Bull in The Pit; get Death of Orion and upgrade it.
Prepare Fire Bomb; begin the wood wait early. Save a bullet weapon for precision kills.
Find the blue-marked Temple skull → Specialist → Flooded Crypt grinder → collect bone meal.
Flooded Crypt: locate the active grinder in one of these three recesses.
Gladiator axe into a pyre → wood over Odin’s cauldron → wait and collect charcoal.
Collect dung at minimum affinity; mix all three ingredients in Zeus’s Bath House bowl.
Plant between Danu’s trees; wait for green smoke; Fire Bomb a zombie on top.
Whole team on blue cracks → destroy red growth floor by floor → return teleport.

bo4-ix.title: Ra — bull targets & the symbol kill order

steps.html: Shield-shoot four bull targets; kill each summoned Gladiator.
Nine possible bull sightlines; only four are active in your match.
Start at Ra’s obelisk; record four glyphs in the order they flash.
Follow the four-target order twice; clear the recorder for each fresh display.

bo4-ix.title: Zeus — raise rods & charge four circles

steps.html: Central stone → raise four underground rods → stunned Kill-O-Watt kills inside four circles.
Four rod positions: Odin Tunnel, Cursed Room, Danu Tunnel and Collapsed Tunnel.
Align and shoot three groups: Danu Tunnel, The Pit and The Crypts.
All players on The Pit’s rear grate → clear lockdown waves → collect key.
Resupply before all players activate the red Arena portal.
Clear the opening wave → break Fury’s red side-armor points → shoot its forehead.
Repeat the full armor and head cycle on Wrath; defeat both elephants.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 1 · Open the ship and prepare your equipment

steps.html: Activate Sentinel; touch all four Pack-a-Punch pedestals.
Collect three shield parts and build at the Poop Deck.
Drain both flooded sections.
Kraken acquired; Distillation Kit built.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 2 · Match four clock symbols to eight controls

steps.html: Record the four active glyphs and clock times.
Bridge minutes → Engine Room Fire/Water hours → Poop Deck Air/Earth hours.
Clocks locked; start the outlet hunt.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 3 · Create circles, then clear four trials in order

steps.html: Locate four active outlets and record their elements.
Create one matching Catalyst circle per round.
Complete Poison, Water, Electric, Fire trials; collect every artifact.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 4 · Flood the Turbine Room and restore the artifact

steps.html: Poison Kraken: convert all nine steam leaks into water leaks.
Pack-a-Punch the artifact at Turbine Room.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 5 · Activate nine symbols and follow the orb route

steps.html: Activate nine symbols, then watch the Cargo Hold model.
Shoot → hold interact on each orb, in order; leave Sun until ready.

bo4-voyage-of-despair.title: 6 · Ice sprint and the Eye of Odin

steps.html: Everyone interacts with Sun orb → break ice → final Poop Deck block.
Enter prepared; survive Poop Deck and Engine Room.
State Rooms → Starboard Deck: damage pupil during beam windows.
Final arena: interrupt three charged wipe attacks.
Both power switches on; shield built; Pack-a-Punch open; Retriever collected.
Read Office code → Citadel pad → Docks crane → Retriever the skeleton → collect Spoon.
Get Monkey Bombs; save one for the Warden’s wall.
Spoon-scratch upstairs wall; lure Brutus to a Monkey Bomb to open the Ritual Room.
Place stone in lab map; interact with the Kronorium to release the bird.

bo4-blood-of-the-dead.title: Find the bird & recover the Kronorium

steps.html: Find and blast the bird on three separate rounds.
Final bird: locate orb → 872 Zombie Blood → reveal with shield → Retriever → pick up book.
Read book code; enter it at Citadel; find and blast the lighthouse-marked portal.
Building 64: finish five fresh Simon sequences; record only the three steady-light symbols.
Take punch card to Model Industries; interact with your three matching monitors.
Blast the spirit at each of the three observed replacement-symbol levers; take the stone.
Finish whichever branch the book assigned; return for a new code.
Keep shield charges available; mark trials complete only after collecting their stones.
Read the shield-visible buoy at Gondola, Recreation Yard and Model Industries.
Add the three digits; enter the total at Sally Port as one or two Morse digits.
Infirmary: reveal and blast ghost, feed nearby kills, escort to Docks, collect stone.
Take the banjo; stay in the blue circle and collect kills.
Return and retake banjo between circles; collect the stone after the final return.

bo4-blood-of-the-dead.title: New Industries — drain & trap the ghost

steps.html: Library: reveal ghost; alternate Spirit Blasts and key drains while following it.
Make ghost fully red; activate blade trap before it arrives; take the stone.
Cafeteria: spawn, reveal and blast the spirit; regroup with it.
Protect the spirit to Michigan Avenue; collect the stone.
Place five stones; Key into corpse; gather at chair; escape cells and recover equipment.
Place final lab orb; resupply; all players activate the arena entrance.
Three cycles: survive → enter red safe zone → shoot orbs → blast central orb.
Complete Richtofen’s chair/crystal sequence, then finish the giant Warden.

cw-die-maschine.title: Power, Pack-a-Punch and the free D.I.E.

steps.html: Power → both terminals → anomaly → marked Aether Tunnel → Machine Part → build Pack-a-Punch.
Megaton splits → Keycard → Weapons Lab remote → charge Living Room suction trap.
Discharge trap → take D.I.E.; primary blasts, alternate fire sucks.
Dark Aether: Yard stairs / plane cockpit / accelerator tunnel → build scope behind Pack-a-Punch.
Medical Bay portal → diary → give it to Medical Bay, Control Room, workbench reflections.
Normal world: activate Medical Bay computer; unlock chamber and upgrade portals.

cw-die-maschine.title: All four D.I.E. upgrades — exact routes

steps.html: Cryo: knock down Penthouse box → flask → Megaton-hit Pond fungus → filled flask → Medical Bay crate.
Nova-5: suck in Mezzanine canister → Weapons Lab unit + Plaguehound → Crash Site crate → melee.
Fire: Pond portal → fuse under floating plane → Weapons Lab cutter → Pond truck crate.
Electric: lower accelerator portal → suck one crystal → shoot crate; repeat for Crash Site, Pond and Penthouse.

cw-die-maschine.title: Charge the chamber and reconstruct Orlov

steps.html: Shoot the four matching chamber ports; each correct arm retracts.
Walkway reflection → wrench → tank ×3 → hatch zombie + grenade → carry Agent to Medical Bay.
Capture both living Megaton halves → all players upstairs → computer → survive.

cw-die-maschine.title: Orlov defense and the escape route

steps.html: Finish supplies → Nacht reflection → pick up family photo to start finale.
Defend Orlov at three systems; clear enemies off him so his work resumes.
Escape: Weapons Lab → Control Room → Tunnel → Crash Site → Pond helicopter.

cw-forsaken.title: Leave Staging Area and lift the lockdown

steps.html: Start teleporter → leave Staging Area → collect four marked repair parts.
Repair portal → bunker → Abomination → tower lockdown switch → separate quest button.
Get Chrysalax by reward or build; neutralizer side components can be prepared meanwhile.

cw-forsaken.title: Build the Chrysalax — three crystals and melee souls

steps.html: Flamethrower kills a Tormentor → collect Tempered Crystal Heart.
Abomination beam hits small Dark Aether crystal → collect Energetic Geode.
Jim’s Donuts crystal → clear hounds, Tempests and Mimics → collect core.
Three crystals into accelerator basin → ten nearby melee kills → collect Chrysalax.

cw-forsaken.title: Aetherium Neutralizer — fuel, shards, monitor and housing

steps.html: All players activate tank controls together → survive Fuel Processing lockdown → collect tank.
Each growth: shoot three orbs → axe crystal → shard into Abomination mouth → red tail → kill + collect.
Dead Wire by Arcade Grand Prix → pay 2,000 → ARC-XD through TV Store vent → detonate behind shelf → collect monitor.
Board Room: Abomination charges wall below housing → collect → build at Main Street bench.

cw-forsaken.title: Neutralizer escort and the final supply stop

steps.html: Activate when ready → stay inside bubble → collect orange route crystals → refuel.
At Containment Door, make final purchases before accepting the boss encounter.

cw-forsaken.title: The Forsaken — expose, charge and fire

steps.html: Break shoulder armor → souls beneath Samantha → cannon into weak point; repeat shoulders, abdomen, head.
Avoid slam, frost and tracking attacks; finish the weak points and allow the scripted ending.
Beast mode: shock power boxes, break crates and grapple to ritual entrances.
Pen → Nero; badge → Ruby Rabbit; belt → Boxing Gym; toupee → Burlesque. Collect all four Gateworms.
Open a rift → place four Gateworms → complete the underground ritual → Pack-a-Punch.
Build the three-district shield, get perks and upgrade a bullet weapon.

bo3-shadows-of-evil.title: Train glyphs, Apothicon Sword and Keeper upgrade

steps.html: Record three train glyphs → shock those shapes on the underground wall.
Charge your egg at the four statues → return it → take the sword.
Your character’s Keeper → four street circles over four rounds → upgraded sword.

bo3-shadows-of-evil.title: Four flag routes and Keeper hand-ins

steps.html: Float Nero’s book → pick up the flag near Widow’s Wine.
Defend both lightning patches, then deliver the charged flag to that district’s Keeper.
Complete one district per round until all four Keepers move underground.

bo3-shadows-of-evil.title: Capture the Shadowman, then coordinate the four-player ending

steps.html: Activate four Keepers → shoot the exposed Shadowman to the table → interact to trap him.
Three station players + one Junction player; one station player calls the train as a human.
Keep rails and Keepers charged through the train impact; wait for the ending cutscene.
Bucket → water both labs → bunker → clear underwater turbine → permanent power.
Power vent + cocoon + underwater tunnel parts → repair three drainage valves → Pack-a-Punch.
Build shield from Lab A, Lab B and artillery parts; build a mask from propeller, green pool and dock parts.

bo3-zetsubou-no-shima.title: Skull of Nan Sapwe and personal trials

steps.html: Match each skull’s actual markings to one of four altars.
Defend and return four skulls → downstairs Keeper ritual → collect Skull.
Every player completes three trials → hold shield in the platform’s lightning.
Scientist vial + caged-spider venom + deep underwater plant → KT-4.
Mesmerize purple-pool poster → reveal elevator wall and underwater planter.
Spider tooth + electrified-cage vial + rainbow plant → Masamune.

bo3-zetsubou-no-shima.title: Grow the flak shell and shoot down the plane

steps.html: Plant → blue water + KT-4 on three consecutive rounds.
Harvest on the following round → collect shell or grow another batch.
Load cannon → shoot passing plane → collect smoking cog at one of three sites.
Reveal mechanism → Anywhere But Here → collect secret-room cog.
Electrified zipline → release over the small dock → collect cog.
Insert all three cogs → prepare Masamune, protection and ammunition.

bo3-zetsubou-no-shima.title: Repair the elevator and defeat the boss

steps.html: Insert three cogs → resupply → elevator → cut orange vines with Masamune.
Survive between openings → Masamune the orange weak points → ending.

bo3-revelations.title: Corruption engines, Pack-a-Punch and the shield

steps.html: Gravestones 2 → 3 → 1 → 4; complete all four corruption engines.
Trap Apothicon at Nacht → enter mouth → shoot three heart tubes → Pack-a-Punch.
Origins + low-gravity Der Eisendrache + Verrückt parts → Nacht shield bench.

bo3-revelations.title: Keeper Protector and upgraded Apothicon Servant

steps.html: Collect skull, crystal and flag → build Keeper altar.
Box Servant → absorb five blue sky rocks → Pack-a-Punch; obtain Arnies and an upgraded bullet gun.

bo3-revelations.title: Three audio reels: Keeper, Arnies and bones

steps.html: Pointed jump-pad rock → Keeper ritual → defend → play reel at Nacht.
Arnies into nine holes in three batches → clear each Margwa wave → play reel at Kino.
Release six bones with upgraded bullets → absorb each with upgraded Servant.
Nacht bone pile → Servant twice → play third reel at Origins.

bo3-revelations.title: SOPHIA, Kronorium, four eggs and gateworms

steps.html: Four turret beams → reflector rocks → SOPHIA → Kino teleporter → bedroom book → stage podium.
Find egg → acid-pool incubator → owner supplies souls → collect gateworm.
Follow gateworm beeps → interact at the source → collect rune; repeat for all four.

bo3-revelations.title: Kronorium sequence, four arenas and seven relics

steps.html: Projection-room circle → read four book runes → enter exact order at cycling symbol.
Survive all four terrain / Margwa phases → collect Summoning Key.
Key hits seven photographed relics → confirm every hit → return to Kino.
Final teleporter → pedestal → charge key → throw at SOPHIA.
Shoot Shadowman into statue mouth → use Kronorium → ending ends the match.
Super rewards: check actual BO3 quest-completion icons before the final run.
Amphitheater artifact → survive → collect bridle → kill Gegenees and take shield body.
Build Apollo’s Will; ride Pegasus; Specialist-open both cages; survive at Pack-a-Punch.
Oracle clue → pictured purple-glowing container → melee → hand → chosen shrine.
Claim enough tribute rewards for 9 points per player; confirm the blue Eternal Flame.
Burning shield spear → ignite all three oil patches.
Stand in Charon’s blood pool at Zeus; single-shot the glowing-eyed statue, four times.
Expose three cog sets → spear at contact → lock Stoa statues facing the crystal.
Gaia: one root → one shot through the pair → one shot through the group of three.
Gegenees shield blast frees Ankh → kill root Gegenees for pole → install pole in sundial.
Give Ra the Ankh and Redeemed Hemera; protect beam; return the revealed scepter.
Electric Catalyst on sundial → stop three blue marks under the light line.
Own-color circle; stands = normal shot; floor = charged shot; grayscale = return home.
Shoot the six numbered door panels in order; restart if the lights clear.
Pegasus Strike at blue mark → Ouranos turns ballista → burning spear through venom → melee ballista.
Resupply and charge Specialist before entering the portal behind Pack-a-Punch.

bo4-ancient-evil.title: Pegasus & Perseus — damage windows and safe islands

steps.html: Gunfire grounds Pegasus; orange glow means Specialist damage.
Perseus teleports in → weapon damage → orange vulnerability → Specialist → collect key.
Power House → Generators lockdown → repair four gassing vents → Pack-a-Punch in Beds.
Collect shield parts in Cul-de-sac, Operations and Beds; build a Riot Shield.
Next round: activate Rushmore; obtain Galvaknuckles, Telepads and a Brain Rot weapon.

bo4-alpha-omega.title: TV broadcast → five clocks → Rushmore code

steps.html: Galvaknuckle-kill by the active static TV; record all five letter/time clues in order.
Set each target clock in broadcast order: interact for minutes; melee for hours.
Interact with the remaining clock; read its final time and enter HHMM at Rushmore.
Escort the red crawler alive to Transfusion Facility; return to Rushmore.
Enter 7626 → Sawyer → McCain → Pernell at Rushmore.
A.D.A.M. from Storage → Marlton’s Diner stairs door → canister into Transfusion rack.

bo4-alpha-omega.title: Timed server delivery & three painting codes

steps.html: Charge the Power House server with a Jolting Jack; teleport its core to Operations.
Brain Rot the three paintings; record and enter every exposed four-digit code.
UP: Diner / Beds / Generators. DOWN: Solitary / Storage / Lounge. Restore main power.
Defend three sparking mannequins; collect both arms and the head.
Repair A.D.A.M. in APD Interrogation; escort the orb from Yellow, Green or Beds.
Resupply; all players activate APD Control; fill the first canister with mannequin kills.
Activate and fill backup canisters in Storage, Diner, Lounge and Beds; leave each charged room.
Push the Avogadro into the APD with gunfire → terminal → collect Elemental Shard.
Docks + Bridge power → blue cave rock → Hermit at Lighthouse Level 4.
Stern crank → Sun Deck; Forecastle crank → Main Deck; collect Handle → Human Infusion power.
Build shield from Docks, Frozen Crevasse/Lagoon and Lighthouse parts.
Finish two complete three-challenge totems, claim rewards, then collect the Hermit’s dials.

bo4-tag-der-toten.title: Four dials, three offerings & the Seal safe

steps.html: Place and turn four dials until they ding; collect the three riddle offerings.
Use the Seal riddle → melee covering → dynamite safe → collect Seal.
Place Seal beneath the red orb in Artifact Storage; have a Music Box ready.
Release three orange orbs → snowball from a distance → shoot each frozen orb home.
Freeze/shoot returned orbs → Seal to Sunken Path fire → Music Box → wait and collect.
Heat both stones at Boathouse → stay dry → one hot stone + one Decontamination-cooled stone into Human Infusion.
Human Infusion fuse → Lighthouse Station box; Wunderwaffe-shoot both red tower batteries.
Electric zombie kills at all three generators → open Lighthouse Station door → take Shard.
Repeat the three roaming orbs, their return and the Music Box campfire ritual.
Fully upgrade and resupply → give Seal to Hermit → survive Lighthouse lockdown → retrieve Seal.

bo4-tag-der-toten.title: Four ordinary Pack-a-Punch charges & final ritual

steps.html: Charge and retrieve Seal at Beach, Lagoon, Sunken Path and Boathouse.
Third ritual stays in Artifact Storage → final Sunken Path Music Box → collect Seal.
Sun Deck flinger → Golden Pack-a-Punch → charge Seal until the protective bubble appears.
Escort inside the bubble; charge it at stops; cross lava on rocks; survive the shrinking Human Infusion zone.
Collect device → give to Hermit → watch from Sun Deck → claim Agarthan Device on Forecastle.

bo3-the-giant.title: Power and all three teleporter links

steps.html: Open the rear courtyard → power switch below the catwalk.
Link every teleporter back to spawn → Pack-a-Punch a weapon.

bo3-the-giant.title: Fly Trap: activate the beacon and earn the Annihilator

steps.html: Shoot the distant control panel with a Pack-a-Punched weapon.
Shoot the furnace monkey, high balcony bear and bear in the liquid vat.
Claim the Annihilator from the furnace to finish Fly Trap.
Teleport a live Monkey Bomb from each of the three teleporters.
Three green lamps → mainframe button → buy the revealed Stamin-Up or Deadshot.

bo4-classified.title: Power, shield & Pack-a-Punch at Groom Lake

steps.html: Offices → War Room → laboratories → power behind Soda; build shield.
Pad in Main Offices + wires in Morgue + amplifier in Panic Room.
Build and place amplifier on small pad; DEFCON 5 + central teleporter → Groom Lake.

bo4-classified.title: Project Skadi — reveal four pictured codes

steps.html: Prepare an explosive for the Labs clue and a Pack-a-Punched gun.
Record each four-digit code by picture; keep leading zeroes.
War Room key → central Main Offices desk drawer → Der Riese code.
Explosive behind Labs machinery → Shangri-La picture right of barrier.
DEFCON: upper far → Server → upper near → lower; Server teleporter → static TV.
Pack-a-Punched shots into nameplates: 1 → 3 → 2 → 4.
Submit Shi No Numa → Der Riese → Shangri-La → Kino; green light confirms each.
Stay together at Groom Lake for three full rounds; open cleared-area case; take Winter’s Howl.
Story target: finish round 149. Prepare shield-bench loadout before the long run.
Shield raised at Weapon Testing bench; rotate Wraith Fire, Ragnaroks and shield gun.
Survive to the transition into round 150 for the ending.
Turn on power and use all three lunar lander stations. Launch the rocket to reach Pack-a-Punch.
Prepare Gersh Devices, Matryoshka Dolls and upgraded high-damage weapons for the final orb stage. Coordinate equipment across the team.
Throw a Gersh Device at the generator outside the playable area near the PhD/Widow’s Wine side, then activate the monitor by the Stamin-Up lander.
During a monkey round, assign all four players to the four perk-area buttons and press them together.
With Pack-a-Punch open, stand together on the platform beneath the rocket for one full clock rotation without leaving it.
Keep one rider aboard while teammates call the lander: Spawn → Stamin-Up, Stamin-Up → Spawn, Spawn → Speed Cola, Speed Cola → Stamin-Up.
Collect the letters along those flights to spell LUNA and activate the fourth node.
At the Casimir device near Stamin-Up, use a Gersh Device at the glowing orb and apply the required explosive/wonder-weapon damage as a team.
Continue until the orb rises and the quest confirmation plays. This quest has its own reward rather than a conventional boss arena.
Activate both underground power switches. Coordinate the pressure plates for Pack-a-Punch access and obtain the 31-79 JGb215.
Assign players to the four spawn buttons and press them together to enter Eclipse. Re-enter Eclipse for stages that require it.
Divide the tile areas between players. Reveal symbols, record positions on both sides and step on matching pairs in coordination.
For the water-slide sequence, arrange three players at the bottom while the final player completes the lever/slide interaction. Confirm the step succeeds before moving on.
Use the baby gun and slide route for the meteor step. Complete the Napalm zombie gas-leak route without killing the required zombie too early.
Use Spikemores for the tunnel-hole step, then complete the stone-symbol and mud-dial interactions using their reference patterns.
Listen to the gongs and identify the correct resonance before the focusing-stone interaction.
Complete the final Eclipse actions and open the route to the focusing stone. Coordinate the team’s positioning before collecting it.
A player’s reward and any repeated run for additional rewards should be tracked separately; reset only the relevant quest checklist.
Escape Area 51 to the Moon, collect a PES and restore power. Use the Hacker carefully: without a PES you need breathable areas.
Prepare the Wave Gun, Gersh Devices and QEDs as the quest requires. Keep access to Tunnel 6 for the sphere stage.
Complete the first Samantha Says sequence at the four screens by repeating each display in order.
Use the Hacker for the laboratory terminal/button stage and finish its timed interactions.
Wait for Excavator Pi to breach Tunnel 6, then stop the excavator with the Hacker when the quest’s tunnel condition has been satisfied.
Follow the sphere through Tunnel 6, using the appropriate weapon interactions and Wave Gun satellite shot to move it onward.
Guide the sphere into the MPD, then fill the required soul stage to open the chamber.
Return to Area 51 for the plates. Use the Gersh/QED interactions to move them into place and find the cable for the Vril device/computer sequence.
Complete the device/computer stage and fill the four soul canisters. Keep the team supplied while moving between the charge areas.
Repeat the later Samantha Says sequences, clearing the helper for each attempt. Finish the final sphere/device interactions to launch the rockets.
Choose which staircase and Help-room routes to open based on the team’s training space. Leaving a route closed changes how zombies reach the upper floor.
Use the Mystery Box and Wunderfizz for equipment. The scoped cabinet weapon and perk options differ from the original World at War version.
Find and activate the four small Samantha buttons around the map. Listen for the success cue, then interact with the starting doll.
Shoot the appearing dolls through the sequence, following their sound and sightlines. Collect the reward after completion.
The radio is a separate music interaction. Keep it separate from the Samantha buttons and do not expect it to unlock a main quest.
Use the source’s images for small button and doll sightlines; the helper tracks completed stages, not unseen target positions.
Identify whether you started on the Jugger-Nog or Quick Revive side. Open that side’s upstairs route toward the power room.
Turn on power to reconnect the starting halves. Coordinate purchases so both sides retain enough space and ammunition.
Use the map’s traps and BO3 equipment options. Do not apply the original version’s Mystery Box contents automatically.
Perform the toilet interaction sequence to start the Chronicles Samantha secret, then follow the doll sequence and collect its reward.
Use the toilet/music interaction separately when playing the map’s song. Listen for the cue before repeating an interaction.
Open the central route and choose a hut to explore. Record the perk revealed at each hut; locations are randomized between matches.
Use the Flogger and avoid becoming trapped in the slowing water. Keep an escape route when opening a new hut.
Obtain the Wunderwaffe from the BO3 weapon pool if desired; there is no Vanguard-style build quest here.
Shoot the four pans for the Chronicles Samantha activation, then follow the bridge/doll sequence and collect the reward.
Interact with the telephone for the map’s music secret. This is independent of hut perk assignments.
Open a route from the lobby to the stage and switch on power. Link the teleporter at the stage and then the mainframe in the lobby.
Use the linked teleporter for the Pack-a-Punch room. Watch the return timing and finish purchases before being moved onward.
Collect film reels from the intermission rooms and use the projector when available.
Interact with the three meteorite fragments to activate the music secret.
For the Chronicles Samantha sequence, listen to the three groups of knocks and record each count. Repeat the observed pattern at the interaction point.
Continue the resulting doll sequence and collect its reward. Clear the knock recorder for a new attempt rather than appending an old pattern.

cw-outbreak.title: Region preparation and how Outbreak works

steps.html: Tiers 1–2: armor, rarity, Pack-a-Punch, perks and supplies before the quest.
Tier 3+: Maxis quest radio for Legion, or red rifts for Operation Excision.
Use the region finder; no projector in Ruka and no starting red rift in Sanatorium.
Ravenov Implications / Inversiya: radio → projector → Ruka bunker → Legion.
Operation Excision: red rifts → Sanatorium rover → Orda → helicopter.

cw-outbreak-ravenov.title: World tier 3 — Maxis radio and amplifiers

steps.html: Prepare in tiers 1–2; search the quest radio from world tier 3.
Activate quest radio → clear enemies → match all three amplifiers to its signal.
Radio device → finish region objective → beacon Respond to Maxis → warp.

cw-outbreak-ravenov.title: Microfilm, projector and the forced Ruka warp

steps.html: Next region: find marked monkey → shoot → collect microfilm; Ruka needs another warp.
Projector: play all three sequences → prepare → next warp forces Ruka.
Forced Ruka → final supplies → silo elevator → Silo A “Lift the Lockdown”.

cw-outbreak-ravenov.title: Three launch keys — monkey, canister and Mimic

steps.html: A: tunnel trap → glowing monkey vent → place trap → retreat → trigger → key.
B: 20 crystals → charge canister → D jellyfish stairs → canister pulse → collect key inside.
Hub: clear Mimics → interact with Silo C corridor body → kill red HVT → take key.

cw-outbreak-ravenov.title: Read the console lights and defeat Legion

steps.html: Read A/B/D small lights: left = first, middle = second, right = third; insert in that order.
Accepted sequence → central hub stairs → surface Legion fight; watch the live countdown.
Break chest → destroy one exposed orb → repeat until all three orbs are gone.

cw-outbreak-excision.title: World tier 3 — red-rift chain and Ravenov contact

steps.html: Tier 3+: enter ground red rift → steer through successive sky rifts → follow falling beam.
Collect listening device at beam landing; Sanatorium has no starting rift.
Complete objective → beacon Respond to Ravenov → warp to Sanatorium.

cw-outbreak-excision.title: Sanatorium — helicopter, red orb and Aether Bunny

steps.html: Northwest Carved Hills helicopter → clear wave → play crash recording.
Find red orb → shoot from behind to push it toward central bridge rover.
Broken box bunny → defend → carry to rover → install → listen to dropped recording.

cw-outbreak-excision.title: Escort, rooftop recording and Orda exfil

steps.html: Final supplies → activate rover → escort inside safe bubble to Monument Walk.
Monument roof → play recording → immediately travel to East Gardens exfil.
East Gardens: defeat Orda and remaining hostiles → board helicopter before timeout.

bo6-liberty-falls.title: Open the town & prepare your route

steps.html: Open church → Pack-a-Punch → interact with the S.D.G. on the right wall.
Bring armor, an upgraded damage weapon and distractions for stationary objectives.

bo6-liberty-falls.title: Build the Thrustodyne M23 / Jet Gun

steps.html: Flower-shop valve → Liberty Lanes wall panel → hold interact → collect pressure gauge.
Kill Cemetery Groundskeeper → take key → unlock yard toolshed → collect handbrake.
Mangler blast opens Radio House → search floor piles → collect electrical wires.
All three parts → upstairs Motor Lodge workbench → build Jet Gun.
Vacuum LTG parts: Comics ceiling / Buzz’s Cuts upper window / church balcony.
Craft LTG on The Alamo bank roof; open your church return route.

bo6-liberty-falls.title: First capture — Riverside to Pump & Pay

steps.html: Carry S.D.G. canister to the Pump & Pay trap; drop beside one ground emitter.
Defend Riverside portal → weaken the named HVT → lure it to the canister.
Kill HVT in active field beside canister → pick up charge → return to S.D.G. within 90 seconds.
Read each projector with Counter; Red → Green, Green → Red, Yellow → Yellow.
Three beams meet at Pump & Pay → collect second canister → retrieve Riverside LTG.

bo6-liberty-falls.title: Second capture — Cemetery to Hill Street

steps.html: Hill Street canister → Cemetery LTG defense → weaken, lure and capture the second HVT.
Return charged canister before timeout; resupply before the church finale.
Restock armor, ammo and equipment → all players accept the S.D.G. encounter.
Wave 1 → Max Armor. Wave 2 → HVT Mangler → Max Ammo.
Final wave → kill HVT Abomination → scripted down → ending.
Defend AMPs in Guard Station → Living Quarters → Bio Lab.
Raise submerged Bio Lab lift → Pack-a-Punch → equip Dead Wire for the free Beamsmasher.

bo6-terminus.title: Open the Research Office & collect the EMF Fob

steps.html: Dead Wire: lift window box → left wall → upper landing → Living Quarters → Rec Yard.
Research Office pinned zombie → EMF Fob → Sea Tower case → Resonator onto lab terminal.
Activate Docks, Storage and Communications laptops; return to terminal for X/Y/Z notes.
Enter 2X+11 → 2Z+Y−5 → absolute value of Y+Z−X.
Wait for scan completion → retrieve Resonator → boat to Castle Rock Island.
Castle Rock: kill orb-marked blue zombies → carry their energy into the large orb.
Pick up Resonator between stages: Castle Rock blue → Crab green → Temple purple → AMP Munition → craft.
Find damaged Tentacle Trap → activate and beam it → Hard Drive → Peck.
Nathan code: clock hour → Mess Hall playing card → Engineering injury sign.
All players hold valves → defeat Nathan while circling the lab.
Collect underwater Janus Keycard → Communications green-text computer.
Shipwreck underside ladder → collect connector → survive lockdown.
Repair the two empty endpoints among Docks / Sea Caves / Crab Island → collect Hacking Device.

bo6-terminus.title: Prepare once, then hack buoys & defuse bombs

steps.html: Resupply and stage a boat before the first buoy; bomb timer follows immediately.
Hack all three sea buoys within the two-minute sequence.
Bio Lab: defuse two lower bombs and one upper bomb before the five-minute match-ending timer.

bo6-terminus.title: Patient 13 — weak points, cover & three phases

steps.html: Bombs safe → finish upgrades and ammo budget → all players accept Patient 13 entrance.
Phase 1: red shoulders; dodge slams/sweeps and clear specials.
Intermission: clear threats and refill. Phase 2: arm weak points, then glowing mouth.
Phase 3: blue charge means hide or dive; avoid tongue; shoot glowing eyes/active weak points.
Cannon opens castle → Oubliette crate locks → Doppelghast crystal → Pack-a-Punch.
Speak to Krafft in Dungeon; open Alchemical Lab; prepare armor and Melee Macchiato.
Round 10 onward: four Stamps → Dragon, Stag, Raven and Lion swords.
Dragon statue → carry all three brazier flames home → collect Caliburn.
Rods: Deadshot ground pickup; Dead Wire box near Speed Cola; Dungeon zombie with Stag sword.
Storm vase: charge sword → melee vase, three times → insert sword → Durendal.
Alchemical Lab antiquity + Raven sword → Tavern Cellar rune wheel.
Align the correct element and zodiac at six o’clock; confirm.
Guide three orbs into each of three portals → return to wheel → Balmung.
Four gold Parasite melee charges → four strikes on the lion door → enter.
Pedestal displays target → shoot matching floating symbol; repeat four times → Solais.
Item → correct ritual circle → nearby kills → matching sword opens chest.
Light three high pyres → kill spawned enemies → Ankh to Courtyard → Fire Incantation.
Stable horseshoe → ride cannon → retrieve horseshoe under storm cloud → Town Square ritual.
Shoot slide raven → shoot flying raven → talon to Undercroft ritual → Dark Incantation.
Align red crystal beams → collect brooch from lab bust → Dining Hall ritual → Light Incantation.

bo6-citadelle-des-morts.title: Tavern bottles, four pages & Point of Power traps

steps.html: Melee Macchiato wall → record bottle runes I–VI → shoot matching sequence.
Four Sitting Rooms page fragments → restore the Undercroft book.
Match and finish four traps in book order; confirm each page dims.
Optional repeat-run shortcut: read page spawn groups before collecting them.

bo6-citadelle-des-morts.title: Salute the knights & charge the Mystic Orb

steps.html: Read I–IV animal order → matching sword + incantation + inspect → take Mystic Orb.
Courtyard orb: fire kills → retrieve charged orb.
Town Square orb: electric kills → retrieve orb.
Undercroft orb: shadow kills → retrieve orb.
Dining Hall orb: run through green light orbs → retrieve completed orb.
Charged orb → Secret Study → recording → Guardian Key; resupply before committing.
Town Square statue key → break armor → focus glowing weak points.
Avoid red landing circles and lava; use immune phases to clear enemies and resupply.
Defeat all three phases → collect amulet → ending.

bo6-the-tomb.title: Enter the Nexus & prepare for the Staff

steps.html: Dig Site → Subterranean Temple pedestal → open and enter Dark Aether Nexus.
Prepare armor/bullet damage; learn blue spawn, yellow Shrine, green Ossuary and red Temple portals.
Round 8 Shock Mimic → collect Monocle; enter Nexus before puzzles.
Tombs lantern faces bull → shoot I–VIII → five-wave defense → Staff piece.
Catacombs lantern by Crafting Table → shoot I–X → five-wave defense → Head Piece.
Nexus central altar → protect forming Staff → collect Staff of Ice.

bo6-the-tomb.title: Ull’s Arrow — lantern sprint, three glyphs & escort

steps.html: Position three lanterns → freeze all three within ten seconds → listen for confirmation.
Staff-shoot three marked Nexus rocks; record all three glyphs.
Outside Nexus: find blocked gateway → shoot your three glyphs → check ground symbols.
All players follow and feed the orb → central altar interaction → Ull’s Arrow.

bo6-the-tomb.title: The four statue trials & fragile return charges

steps.html: Healing shot on Nexus statue → matching outside trial → carry charge back → deposit.
Vermin: Nexus → Dig Site defense → safe return → Nexus Vermin deposit.
Parasite: Shrine trial → kill purple Parasites, collect and deposit orbs → return charge.
Doppelghast: Ossuary defense; avoid spike circles → carry charge home.
Amalgam: Deep Excavation; kill shield-tether zombies → finish HVT → return charge.
Lost return charge? Recollect at outside statue and retry delivery; confirm each beam.

bo6-the-tomb.title: Sentinel Artifact — damage windows, HVTs & final burst

steps.html: Four statue beams → bridge; prepare PaP III legendary bullet weapon and survival supplies.
Orange/spinning = evade. Purple/stationary = focus bullet damage.
Kill the orange-artifact carrier → shoot dropped artifact; ignore the pale decoy.
Final bell → shoot artifact at back wall immediately → finish health bar → ending.

bo6-shattered-veil.title: Repair the elevator & prepare your route

steps.html: Library zombie → Fuse; Director’s computer → Circuit Board; repair Banquet Hall elevator.
Equip Aether Shroud; reserve Brain Rot, a Kazimir, Combat Axes and an explosive.

bo6-shattered-veil.title: The free Mark II & Nursery cipher

steps.html: Round 10+: Lab Technician → disk → East Foyer computer → printed protocol.
Count each protocol letter’s full cluster → cell keypad → Doppelghast arm → Armory Mark II.
Base Mark II → four blue-crystal locations → collect one empty canister.
Kazimir in front of the Rear Patio window → collect extracted canister.
Read tube letter → axe the closed feed valve and matching A/B valve → explode filled tube.
Henge: beam then charge three rocks → defend siphon → Supply Depot Mark II-W.
Banquet Hall Sconce → Juggernog lamp sequence → Distillery computer → W kills → enter painting.
Study Bell → Overlook bar → Brain Rot zombie + ring → Flask → Distillery ritual.
W breaks the Mangler shield; defeat it and reclaim the Sentinel Artifact.

bo6-shattered-veil.title: Mark II-P & the Banquet Hall spirit

steps.html: Janus crates → Essence Bomb; two fountain Reflectors → bomb armor-side rubble → Serpent Mound.
Reflect beam → strike source crystal → kill statue; repeat three times → Director’s Mark II-P.
P kills → Banquet painting → Elixir → Bottlery, Overlook and Garden Pond chalices.
Wall pairs left to right → West Hallways safe → Antler → P ritual → reclaim Artifact.
Burn/explode outdoor growths → collect four seeds.
Conservatory: four seed defenses → Toxic Canister → Garden Pond R → Library portal.
Aether Shroud → collect Audio Log, Ledger and ID Badge.
Three glowing books in confirmed order → Inspection Report → R ritual → reclaim Artifact.
All three Artifacts reclaimed → upgrade, refill and activate S.A.M.’s console.
Use walls, avoid poison, kill adds for ammo; punish glowing eyes/flanks and safe mouth openings.
Later phases: brief damage windows, move around walls, preserve an escape; finish Z-Rex.
Executive Office snow globe → Sublevel 10 accelerator → break all crystals → Pack-a-Punch.
Save dropped Klaus arms; keep an explosive; plan Melee Macchiato and the spawn bucket.
Geneticist keycard → Test Area fridge DNA; take the Lab’s syringe.
Beam knocks body down → draw blood → Syringe back → defeat Fowler → special Injection.
Fowler Injection at Containment scanner → access Teleportation Lab.
Deadshot initial + family-tank initial → element atomic number → three-digit keypad.
Cyst absorbs 3 Vermin then 3 zombies → collect → drain 3 yellow Flora.
Activate four surge terminals quickly → break Uber Klaus shoulders → lure onto energized panel.
Defeat possessed robot and core → Cyst into orb → Gorgofex.
Two robot arms + two Android Assembly legs → install on hanging Franken-Klaus.
Uber Klaus electricity → Franken-Klaus terminal → next round → finish S.A.M. trial → Teleportation Lab.
Find four folders → sort dates oldest to newest → read their four file numbers.
Enter chronological file code at Teleportation Lab computer.

bo6-reckoning.title: Timed brain delivery & portal crystal removal

steps.html: Melee Macchiato brain container → carry quickly to chamber beside Klaus.
Boost accelerator → Gorgofex kills on 5 Quantum Vermin → absorb orb → charged portal shot.
Charged shot at Core wall opening → head → bucket under sprinkler → explosive smoke detector.
Wash head → collect souls until purple → install in portal → confirm fungal growth.

bo6-reckoning.title: Four vacuum captures & the last lockdown

steps.html: Janus containers → special devices → capture and collect 4 floating purple objects.
Insert 4 captures → start defense → turn each active red lever green until complete.
Resupply before Tower 3. Help Richtofen → fight S.A.M.; help S.A.M. → fight Richtofen.
Attune and choose → Vault 1 three soul canisters → Vault 2 all crystals → roof.
S.A.M.: dodge beam → break glowing vents → red eye damage; complete intermission trials.
Richtofen: shoulders → exposed core/head; then cover, smoke/Shroud and dodge jetpack attacks.
